Subject: Draft plan: priority invite branches + deadline reminders

Team —

Putting the plan in one thread so we can finalize copy and the send schedule for the developer-focused webinar (Dec 28). High-level goals: 1) prioritize mid/late-stage developer signups (engage with code + repo activity), 2) short deadline reminders to drive RSVPs before speaker list lock, 3) fallback for low open segments.

Key asks:
- Marissa: please share two subject-line stems (urgent + evergreen) and a 3-email cadence per segment.
- Olga: add final tracking link matrix and the branch UTM mapping into the RSVP sheet.
- Karthik: confirm segment definitions (active devs, infra architects, enterprise POCs) and whether we should do early-bird CTA variants.

Attached: webinar-email-copy-v3.docx (copy with variant tags) and rsvp-tracking-sheet-202612.xlsx (draft).

Proposed timeline:
- Dec 11: finalize copy + subject lines
- Dec 13: QA tracking links and test sends
- Dec 16: send initial invite to prioritized list
- Dec 22 & 26: deadline reminders (24h + 48h out variants)

Thanks —
Lauren

Thanks Lauren — this looks solid. Quick notes inline and two subject line stems below (dev-focused + urgent):

Subject A (developer): "Hands-on: Cutting inference latency for real apps — Join our live lab"
Subject B (urgent/deadline): "Seats filling: RSVP by Dec 22 to save your spot"

Cadence (per prioritized segment):
- Day 0: Personalized invite (short value props, two CTAs: RSVP / Add to calendar)
- Day 6: Use-case spotlight (developer sample + speaker quote)
- Day 12 (deadline): 24h reminder with "last chance" subject variant

I also recommend an extra microbranch for waitlisted signups: send a "we saved you a seat if X happens" nudge the morning of the event.

I'll update the copy doc with the two CTAs and short-alt copy for subject-line length tests.

—Marissa

Subject: Re: Draft plan: priority invite branches + deadline reminders

Couple of segmentation tweaks from product analytics:

- Active devs: users with >=3 API calls/week in last 30 days (we'll pull this list from analytics export).
- Infra architects: filter by job_title keywords ("platform", "infra", "SRE") and filter out trial accounts.
- Enterprise POCs: HubSpot property "deal_stage" in ("POC", "contracting") — send only the high-touch branch with a rep intro.

Subject tests: short/long + emoji test for small dev sample (emoji increases opens for devs historically).

One ask: add a fallback branch for low-open-rate group — use a different From name ("Marissa from Redwood") and single-sentence body. That tends to recover about ~6% more opens.

Karthik
